title: GRESO：rollout 前选择性预过滤账（DataProfiler 六种 skip + 预过滤累积 + 零方差自适应补采样 + p_easy/p_hard 探索率自适应）
title_en: GRESO: Pre-Rollout Selective Filtering (DataProfiler's Six Skips + Filtered-Batch Accumulation + Zero-Variance Adaptive Refill + p_easy/p_hard Exploration Adaptation)
source_lines: verl/trainer/ttis/presampling_selector.py 全文件（DataProfiler skip 族 + filter_examples_*）+ verl/trainer/ttis/ttis.py::filter_zero_advantage + verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py 自适应采样与 p 自适应尾段（L949-1236 区段）
description: GRESO 的核心主张：不是所有 prompt 都值得 rollout——用历史 reward trace 预测低价值 prompt（一直全对的太简单、一直全错的太难/不可解）并在 rollout 前跳过，省下的预算由零方差过滤后的自适应补采样吃满。官方 verl 实现的确定性账（DataProto/engine 剥除，reward trace、batch、随机源全入参），七入口复刻：id——data id = f"{data_source}_{index}"；trace——(epoch, reward) 追加式轨迹；skip 五变体——easy_example（trace 内任意 reward 恰 ==1 且 epoch+n≥current，n=−1 永久 10e7）、easy/hard_linear_backoff（从尾数连续段：easy 断在 <0.98、hard 断在 >0.11 且**最新 reward >0.11 直接不可 hard-skip**（可解例保护门），count==0 早退，backoff=randint(0, k·count) 锚在**全 trace** max_epoch 上）、easy/hard_probabilistic（同 count、skip_prob=1−max(p^count, 0.01)、**无 count==0 早退**（count 0 → prob 0）、rand 惰性采样——门槛短路时不消耗）；filter——all_probabilistic 批过滤：先 easy 后 hard，skip_log 记 [data_id, 0|1|2]（0=easy/1=hard/2=保留）；refill——零方差过滤（组内 reward max==min 整组丢弃）后不足 real_train_batch_size 时估算下一采样量 int(reminder/(1−zero_variance_ratio)/n·1.25)，≤default 置 last_sampling、clamp 到 [64, default]，full_sampling_bs 短路；adapt——hard_ratio ≥ target·2/3 → p_hard −0.01（将来多滤 hard）否则 +0.01，easy_ratio 对 target/3 同理，clamp [0.05, 0.95]，epoch 0 冻结。
description_en: GRESO's core claim: not every prompt deserves a rollout — historical reward traces predict low-value prompts (all-correct = too easy, all-wrong = too hard/unsolvable), which are skipped before rollout, and the saved budget is consumed by the zero-variance-filtered adaptive refill. This problem replicates the deterministic accounting of the official verl implementation (DataProto/engine stripped; traces, batches, and random sources fully parameterized) via seven solve entries: id — data id = f"{data_source}_{index}"; trace — append-only (epoch, reward) trails; five skip variants — easy_example (any reward exactly ==1 in the trace with epoch+n ≥ current; n=−1 forever at 10e7), easy/hard_linear_backoff (trailing-run counts: easy breaks below 0.98, hard breaks above 0.11 with the **latest reward >0.11 hard-instantly-kept** solvable-example gate, count==0 early return, backoff=randint(0, k·count) anchored at the **whole-trace** max epoch), easy/hard_probabilistic (same counts, skip_prob=1−max(p^count, 0.01), **no count==0 early return** (count 0 → prob 0), lazy rand draws — short-circuited gates never sample); filter — all_probabilistic batch filtering: easy first then hard, skip_log recording [data_id, 0|1|2] (0=easy/1=hard/2=kept); refill — after zero-variance filtering (a group with reward max==min is dropped whole) the batch sits below real_train_batch_size, so the next sampling size is estimated as int(reminder/(1−zero_variance_ratio)/n·1.25), last_sampling set when it falls to default, clamped to [64, default], full_sampling_bs short-circuits; adapt — hard_ratio ≥ target·2/3 → p_hard −0.01 (filter more hard later) else +0.01, easy_ratio likewise against target/3, clamped to [0.05, 0.95], frozen at epoch 0.
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) **easy/hard 的语义不对称**：easy 的「太简单」看从尾连续 ≥0.98 的长度（有 0.97 即断），hard 的「太难」要求**最新 reward ≤0.11**（最新 >0.11 = 可解例，直接免 hard-skip）再加从尾连续 ≤0.11 段——hard 门在 count 之前。(2) backoff 锚点是**全 trace 的 max_epoch**（不是连续段的起点）：randint(0, k·count) 后 max_epoch+backoff ≥ current 才跳——线性退避让「刚变简单/难」的例还能被采样几轮。(3) probabilistic 与 backoff 的 count==0 行为不同：backoff 有 count==0 早退、probabilistic 没有——count 0 → p^0=1 → skip_prob=0 → rand<0 恒 False（语义等效但不短路）。(4) **rand 惰性采样**：官方 torch.rand(1) 在门槛短路时不被调用——filter 的 rand 消费序列只含「真正走到随机比较」的检查（a_0 的 hard 门因最新 0.99>0.11 不消费 rand）。入参化随机源必须保持这个惰性。(5) skip_prob 的 0.01 下限：max(p^count, 0.01)——深连续段不会 100% 跳（p^count<0.01 时钳 0.01 → skip_prob=0.99）。(6) refill 估算的 1.25 冗余系数与 [64, default] 双向 clamp；estimated≤default 置 last_sampling=True——下一轮用不满额 batch 也放行（避免死循环）；full_sampling_bs 直接用 default 且重置 last_sampling。(7) p 自适应方向：ratio ≥ target → p −0.01 → p^count 变小 → skip_prob 变大 → 将来滤更多；target_easy=target/3、target_hard=target·2/3（hard 侧留 2/3 探索余量——太难例更可能被解出，过滤得太狠会饿死探索）。(8) 零方差过滤按**组**（n 条 interleave 展开 idx·n+j），组内 reward max==min 即丢——与 DAPO dynamic sampling 同账。(9) 与 to-dapo-loss 划界：DAPO 的 dynamic sampling 在 batch 内过滤（生成后丢零方差组、凑满才训），GRESO 在 batch 前预过滤（DataProfiler 轨迹账）+ 跨步自适应 bs/探索率——本题只收预过滤侧与调度账。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) **Easy/hard asymmetry**: "too easy" reads the trailing run of rewards ≥0.98 (a 0.97 breaks it); "too hard" requires the **latest reward ≤0.11** (latest >0.11 = solvable, instantly exempt from hard skips) plus a trailing run ≤0.11 — the hard gate precedes the count. (2) The backoff anchor is the **whole-trace max epoch** (not the run start): randint(0, k·count) then max_epoch+backoff ≥ current — linear backoff lets recently-easy/hard examples stay sampleable for a few rounds. (3) probabilistic vs backoff differ at count==0: backoff early-returns, probabilistic does not — count 0 → p^0=1 → skip_prob=0 → rand<0 always False (semantically equal but no short-circuit). (4) **Lazy rand draws**: the official torch.rand(1) is never called when a gate short-circuits — the filter's rand consumption sequence contains only checks that actually reach the random comparison (a_0's hard gate consumes nothing because its latest 0.99 > 0.11). Parameterized random sources must preserve this laziness. (5) The skip_prob floor: max(p^count, 0.01) — deep runs never skip 100% (p^count<0.01 clamps to 0.01 → skip_prob=0.99). (6) The refill estimate's 1.25 redundancy factor and the two-way [64, default] clamp; estimated≤default sets last_sampling=True — the next round releases an under-filled batch (avoiding an infinite loop); full_sampling_bs uses the default and resets last_sampling. (7) The p-adaptation direction: ratio ≥ target → p −0.01 → smaller p^count → larger skip_prob → filter more later; target_easy=target/3, target_hard=target·2/3 (the hard side keeps 2/3 exploration headroom — hard examples may become solvable, over-filtering starves exploration). (8) Zero-variance filtering is per **group** (n interleaved rows expanded as idx·n+j); a group with reward max==min is dropped whole — the same ledger as DAPO dynamic sampling. (9) Boundary vs to-dapo-loss: DAPO's dynamic sampling filters inside the batch (drop zero-variance groups after generation, train only when full), while GRESO pre-filters before the batch (the DataProfiler trace ledger) plus cross-step adaptive bs/exploration — this problem covers only the pre-filter and scheduling side.
